fieldNotes.truckGate: Plant sits ~150m back from Pioneer Dr behind an open grass field, reached by an open private loop drive. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point is visible at the road fork or at the operational-yard edge in satellite, and Street View (set on the public road) cannot reach the inner yard. Scored false; the set-back open campus typically runs an uncontrolled or staffed-door entry rather than a road-line gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No 1-3-vehicle booth structure visible at any entry to the yard in z20 imagery.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate (remoteGs requires a gate).
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated ~48 across three banks: a long NW dock apron (~20 trailers backed in under canopies), an N/NE canopied dock line near the silos, and an SE dock bank facing the large maneuvering apron. Bands overlap building faces; honest estimate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on physically separate building faces (NW bank vs SE bank) suggest separated ship/receive flows; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved SE maneuvering/holding apron inside the property ahead of the SE dock bank acts as an internal staging area.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal drives and the deep open SE apron give ample paved width to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur enters the property from the E past the silos (parallel tracks confirmed in z19/z20 NE imagery) — classic bakery flour-rail service.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows on the S/SE hold ~25-40 trailers, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park (Kentucky Transpark corridor) on the outskirts of Bowling Green, fronted by farmland and a divided highway — scored Rural per the small-town tiebreak.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~38 acres for the fenced operational footprint derived from the perimeter ring; the adjacent wooded NE buffer and the active $224M expansion parcel are excluded.
fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via web search (Kroger-owned Country Oven Bakery, 2840 Pioneer Dr, ~450 employees, $224M expansion) and satellite: the supplied coords (36.9722,-86.3870) landed in rural residential ~12km NE and were wrong; the real plant is at 36.9485,-86.4905 — a large multi-section manufacturing building with flour silos, a rail spur, employee parking, and a trailer drop yard.
